classification.difficultyReason: Link class midpoints and running frequency totals to a cumulative histogram, then construct the ogive using successive upper-right bar corners. The zero-frequency class requires keeping the cumulative height unchanged, producing a horizontal segment; these are routine linked procedures supported by the table headings.

content.prompt: Construct a **cumulative** frequency histogram and ogive.

spec.description: Empty construction grid with labelled axis scales matching the accepted solution; no bars, polygon or ogive supplied.
spec.mathematics: Class centres 2,7,12,17; equally spaced boundaries -0.5,4.5,9.5,14.5,19.5; cumulative frequencies 2,6,9,14. Boundary values are not printed.

answer.worked:
Class centre $=\dfrac{\text{lower endpoint}+\text{upper endpoint}}{2}$, giving $2,7,12,17$.

The running frequency totals are $2$, $2+4=6$, $6+3=9$ and $9+5=14$, so $\Sigma f=14$.

Draw touching bars centred at $2,7,12,17$ with heights $2,6,9,14$. Start the ogive at the left edge of the first bar on the baseline, then join the successive upper-right bar corners.

answer.worked:
Class centre $=\dfrac{\text{lower endpoint}+\text{upper endpoint}}{2}$, giving $4.5,14.5,24.5,34.5,44.5,54.5,64.5$.

The running totals are $4$, $4+3=7$, $7+2=9$, $9+0=9$, $9+1=10$, $10+2=12$ and $12+5=17$, so $\Sigma f=17$.

Draw touching bars centred on the class centres with heights $4,7,9,9,10,12,17$. Join the baseline at the left edge of the first bar to the successive upper-right corners. The ogive is horizontal across class $30$–$39$ because its frequency is zero.
